from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import OAuthClientIntegration

class ExportOAuthRefreshTokenView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, integration_id):
        # Validate that the integration belongs to the user's corporate organization
        integration = get_object_or_404(
            OAuthClientIntegration,
            id=integration_id,
            organization=request.user.organization
        )

        return Response({
            "integration_id": integration.id,
            "provider": integration.provider,
            "refresh_token": integration.encrypted_refresh_token
        })
